pairs.target: tǎ wéi dào dōng wū shí , zhuōshàng yǐjīng bǎi zhe sānzhī xiāngzǐ .
pairs.english: When Tavi reached the east room, three boxes already stood on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维到东屋时，桌上已经摆着三只箱子。

pairs.target: zuìdà de nà zhī chǎngzhe gài , lǐmiàn què zhǐyǒu shuāzi , zhǐdài hé jǐkuài guǒbù .
pairs.english: The largest was open, but contained only brushes, paper bags and a few wrapping cloths.
pairs.hanzi: 最大的那只敞着盖，里面却只有刷子、纸袋和几块裹布。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài ménbiān zhǎo zhuāng yàngjiàn de xiǎo xiá . wéi lǎoshī kànjiàn , jiào tā xiān zuò . "
pairs.english: He stood by the door looking for the little sample case. Teacher Vey saw him and told him to sit first.
pairs.hanzi:
他站在门边找装样件的小匣。维老师看见，叫他先坐。
“

pairs.target: zhècì bú dài liànxí tiě jiàn .
pairs.english: “We aren't bringing practice iron this time.
pairs.hanzi: 这次不带练习铁件。

pairs.target: qù kàn biérén liúxiàlái de dōngxī , búshì zài jiù jīqì shàng shì zìjǐ de běnshì . "
pairs.english: We're going to look at what others left behind, not try our skills on old machines.”
pairs.hanzi: 去看别人留下来的东西，不是在旧机器上试自己的本事。”

pairs.target: zhuōpáng yígòng liùzhāng dèngzǐ , dé mǎ zhàn le kàochuāng de yìzhāng , jiǎo biān fàng zhe tā nà kuài xīn lùxiàn bǎn .
pairs.english: There were six stools around the table. Dema had taken one by the window, her new route board at her feet.
pairs.hanzi: 桌旁一共六张凳子，德玛占了靠窗的一张，脚边放着她那块新路线板。

alignment.english: her new route board at her feet

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuò guòqù , fāxiàn shàngmiàn de yàn zhōngyú yǒu le cháng bózi .
pairs.english: Tavi sat beside her and noticed the goose finally had a long neck.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐过去，发现上面的雁终于有了长脖子。

pairs.target: tā gāng xiǎng shuō , dé mǎ biàn bǎ bǎn fān le miàn .
pairs.english: Just as he was about to speak, Dema turned the board over.
pairs.hanzi: 他刚想说，德玛便把板翻了面。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī tānkāi xī qú de tú .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey spread out a map of West Canal.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师摊开西渠的图。

pairs.target: nàbiān yǒu yíchù jiù tíshuǐ zhàn , zhǔjī zǎoyǐ chèzǒu ,
pairs.english: There was an old pumping station there; its main machinery had long since been removed,
pairs.hanzi: 那边有一处旧提水站，主机早已撤走，

pairs.target: shèngxià de láng jià hé fùshǔ cāngfáng zhèngzài zhú duàn qīngdiǎn .
pairs.english: and the remaining gallery frame and auxiliary stores were being inventoried section by section.
pairs.hanzi: 剩下的廊架和附属仓房正在逐段清点。

pairs.target: xuégōng zhècì qù de shì cháyàn zǔ yǐjīng fàngxíng de xīcè lángdào ,
pairs.english: The academy would visit the west gallery already cleared by the inspection team,
pairs.hanzi: 学宫这次去的是查验组已经放行的西侧廊道，

pairs.target: liángchǐcùn , chāo biāojì , héduì chāixiàlái de gòujiàn .
pairs.english: measuring dimensions, copying marks and checking dismantled components.
pairs.hanzi: 量尺寸、抄标记、核对拆下来的构件。

pairs.target: hóngxiàn yǐwài méiyǒu xuéshēng de shì .
pairs.english: Beyond the red lines was no place for students.
pairs.hanzi: 红线以外没有学生的事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ shào lǐ bān qù de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi thought of where Shaoli had moved.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起邵里搬去的地方。

pairs.target: yuánlái " xī qú " búshì yídòng wūzi , yě búshì chuāng xià de yìtiáo shuǐgōu .
pairs.english: So “West Canal” wasn't a single building or a ditch beneath a window.
pairs.hanzi: 原来“西渠”不是一栋屋子，也不是窗下的一条水沟。

pairs.target: tú shàng de cāngfáng lián zhe hǎo jǐduàn táidì , jiùzhàn zài gèng dī chù , zhíbān zhùchù què huà zài pōdǐng . "
pairs.english: The stores on the map linked several terraces; the old station lay lower, while the staff quarters were drawn at the top of the slope.
pairs.hanzi:
图上的仓房连着好几段台地，旧站在更低处，值班住处却画在坡顶。
“

pairs.target: yǒurén zhù zhèlǐ ? " tā zhǐzhe jiùzhàn páng de yìpái xiǎogé . "
pairs.english: “People live here?” He pointed at a row of small squares beside the old station.
pairs.hanzi:
有人住这里？”他指着旧站旁的一排小格。
“

pairs.target: nà shì xiànzài de xǐyī péng . " wéi lǎoshī shuō , "
pairs.english: “That's the current wash shed,” Teacher Vey said.
pairs.hanzi: 那是现在的洗衣棚。”维老师说，“

pairs.target: jiàndào rén , xiān wèn . tú shàng méi huà chū tāmen jīntiān bǎ pén fàngzài nǎlǐ . "
pairs.english: “When you see people, ask first. The map doesn't show where they've put their basins today.”
pairs.hanzi: 见到人，先问。图上没画出他们今天把盆放在哪里。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ tú dì xiàqù , ràng měigè rén zhǎo cóng jíhédiǎn zǒu dào xī láng de lù .
pairs.english: She passed the map around, asking everyone to find the route from the meeting point to the west gallery.
pairs.hanzi: 她把图递下去，让每个人找从集合点走到西廊的路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū le shàngxià liǎngcéng chóngdié de xiàn ,
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the overlapping lines of the upper and lower levels,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出了上下两层重叠的线，

pairs.target: méiyǒu zài bǎ lóushàng de mén dàngchéng chuānqiáng de kǒu .
pairs.english: and no longer mistook an upstairs door for a passage through the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 没有再把楼上的门当成穿墙的口。

pairs.target: tā zài yíchù zhuǎnjiǎo chíyí , dé mǎ zhǐ le zhǐ biānshàng de biāogāo , liǎng rén gèzì zài zhǐ shàng huà wán .
pairs.english: He hesitated at a corner; Dema pointed at the elevation beside it, and they each finished their drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 他在一处转角迟疑，德玛指了指边上的标高，两人各自在纸上画完。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī chá guò qiánjǐcì de jìlù , yòu jiào tāmen bàochū liǎngduàn àn bǐlì huànsuàn de chángdù .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey checked their previous records, then asked for the scaled lengths of two sections.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师查过前几次的记录，又叫他们报出两段按比例换算的长度。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi suàn dìèrduàn shí lòu le bàngé , zìjǐ zhòng kànyíbiàn , gǎi le .
pairs.english: On the second section Tavi missed half a division, looked again himself and corrected it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维算第二段时漏了半格，自己重看一遍，改了。

pairs.target: tā zài míngdān shàng liúxià tā de míngzì , shuō xià gè xiūxirì yìzǎo jíhé , huílái réng gǎndeshàng wǎnfàn .
pairs.english: She kept his name on the list, saying they would meet early next rest day and be back in time for supper.
pairs.hanzi: 她在名单上留下他的名字，说下个休息日一早集合，回来仍赶得上晚饭。

pairs.target: méiyǒu shuí gěi tā yìméi xīn huījì .
pairs.english: Nobody gave him a new badge.
pairs.hanzi: 没有谁给他一枚新徽记。

pairs.target: tā què rěnbúzhù bǎ nà zhāng lùxiàn zhǐ yāpíng yòu yāpíng .
pairs.english: Yet he couldn't help smoothing the route sheet again and again.
pairs.hanzi: 他却忍不住把那张路线纸压平又压平。

pairs.target: sàn hòu , dé mǎ liúzài zhuōbiān wèn shuāzi néng bunéng lìng dài yìbǎ .
pairs.english: Afterwards Dema stayed by the table to ask whether she could bring another brush.
pairs.hanzi: 散后，德玛留在桌边问刷子能不能另带一把。

pairs.target: tā jiālǐ jiàn guò jiù lùbiāo , kè cáo lǐ jī de huī zhī shùnzhe yígè fāngxiàng shuā , zì huì shǎodiào yìbǐ .
pairs.english: She'd seen old road markers at home: brushing the dust in their grooves in only one direction could lose a stroke of a character.
pairs.hanzi: 她家里见过旧路标，刻槽里积的灰只顺着一个方向刷，字会少掉一笔。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiào tā dàilái kànkàn , méi dāngchǎng dāying ná qù yòng .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey asked her to bring it for a look, without immediately approving its use.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师叫她带来看看，没当场答应拿去用。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng tā yìqǐ chūmén .
pairs.english: Tavi waited to leave with her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等她一起出门。

pairs.target: tā shuō xiān zǒu , zìjǐ hái xiǎng wèn cāngfáng túlǐ nà dào shuāngxiàn .
pairs.english: She told him to go ahead: she still wanted to ask about the double line in the store plan.
pairs.hanzi: 她说先走，自己还想问仓房图里那道双线。

pairs.target: tā biàn bǎmén liú zhe , dúzì qù zhǎo yīwén .
pairs.english: He left the door open and went alone to find Iven.
pairs.hanzi: 他便把门留着，独自去找伊文。

pairs.target: héchàng yòng de wūzi gé zhe yígè yuànzi .
pairs.english: The choir room lay across a courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 合唱用的屋子隔着一个院子。

pairs.target: mén kāi zhe , lǐmiàn sāngè rén chàng dé gè yǒu gè de kuàimàn ,
pairs.english: Its door was open; three people inside were singing at three different speeds,
pairs.hanzi: 门开着，里面三个人唱得各有各的快慢，

pairs.target: yīwén zhàn zài zhōngyāng , shǒu jǔ dào yíbàn , liǎnshàng shì yìzhǒng shífēn kèqì de juéwàng .
pairs.english: with Iven standing in the middle, hand half raised, wearing a look of exquisitely polite despair.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文站在中央，手举到一半，脸上是一种十分客气的绝望。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàoqiáng děng .
pairs.english: Tavi waited against the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维靠墙等。

pairs.target: tā tīng chū nà shì děng chuán lái , zhǐshì zhèhuí chuán xiàng tóngshí wǎng sāngè fāngxiàng zǒu .
pairs.english: He recognized Waiting for the Boat, except this time the boat seemed to be going in three directions at once.
pairs.hanzi: 他听出那是《等船来》，只是这回船像同时往三个方向走。

pairs.target: yīwén zhōngyú ràng dàjiā tíngxià , yuē hǎo fànhòu zài lái .
pairs.english: Iven finally stopped everyone, arranging to return after supper.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文终于让大家停下，约好饭后再来。

pairs.target: yígè gāng lái de xiǎogèzi xuéshēng wèn , shìbushì zìjǐ sǎngzi bùhǎo .
pairs.english: A small new student asked whether his voice was bad.
pairs.hanzi: 一个刚来的小个子学生问，是不是自己嗓子不好。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō búshì , xiān bié zhuī zhe zuìgāo de nàge shēngyīn chàng , bǎ zìjǐ nà jù chàng wěn jiù xíng .
pairs.english: Iven said no: stop chasing the highest voice and sing your own line steadily first.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说不是，先别追着最高的那个声音唱，把自己那句唱稳就行。

pairs.target: xiǎogèzi zǒu de shíhòu , réng yìbiān chuān wàiyī yìbiān qīngqīng shì nà jǐgè yīn . "
pairs.english: As the small student left, he was still trying those notes softly while putting on his coat.
pairs.hanzi:
小个子走的时候，仍一边穿外衣一边轻轻试那几个音。
“

pairs.target: nǐ méi qù shuōmínghuì ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “You didn't go to the briefing?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: 你没去说明会？”塔维问。

pairs.target: yīwén wǎng yuàn wài kàn le yìyǎn . " jiǎn lǎoshī nàbiān kuài sàn le .
pairs.english: Iven glanced outside the courtyard. “Teacher Jian's session is nearly over.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文往院外看了一眼。“简老师那边快散了。

pairs.target: wǒ dāying jīntiān bāng tāmen hé qǐlái , zǒng bùnéng chàng yíbàn bǎ rén rēng zài zhèlǐ . " "
pairs.english: I promised to help them put this together today. I can't just abandon them halfway through the song.”
pairs.hanzi:
我答应今天帮他们合起来，总不能唱一半把人扔在这里。”
“

pairs.target: kěyǐ ràng biérén tì yíhuìer . " "
pairs.english: “Someone could stand in for a while.”
pairs.hanzi:
可以让别人替一会儿。”
“

pairs.target: wǒ xiǎng guò . kě zhè shì wǒ tiāo de qǔzi . " yīwén bǎ yǐbèi shàng de wéijīn chěxiàlái , "
pairs.english: “I thought of that. But I chose this song.” Iven pulled his scarf off the chair back.
pairs.hanzi: 我想过。可这是我挑的曲子。”伊文把椅背上的围巾扯下来，“

pairs.target: wǒ xiěxìn wèn le néng bunéng bǔ kàn túcè , tā shuō kěyǐ .
pairs.english: “I wrote to ask if I could look at the charts afterwards, and he said yes.
pairs.hanzi: 我写信问了能不能补看图册，他说可以。

pairs.target: děnghuìer qù ná . kànbùdǒng de , zài zhǎo tā wèn . "
pairs.english: I'll collect them shortly. Anything I don't understand, I'll ask him later.”
pairs.hanzi: 等会儿去拿。看不懂的，再找他问。”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zhuāng chū háobúzàiyì de yàngzi .
pairs.english: He didn't pretend to be completely unconcerned.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有装出毫不在意的样子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō dào xī qú de míngdān shí , tā míngxiǎn xiànmù ,
pairs.english: When Tavi mentioned the West Canal list, his envy was plain,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说到西渠的名单时，他明显羡慕，

pairs.target: què háishì xiān bǎ sānzhāng luò zài dìshàng de qǔpǔ jiǎnqǐlái , àn shùnxù jiá hǎo . "
pairs.english: yet he first picked up three fallen music sheets and filed them in order.
pairs.hanzi:
却还是先把三张落在地上的曲谱捡起来，按顺序夹好。
“

pairs.target: huílái jiǎng gěi wǒ tīng . " yīwén shuō , "
pairs.english: “Tell me about it when you're back,” Iven said.
pairs.hanzi: 回来讲给我听。”伊文说，“

pairs.target: bié zhī jiǎng nǐ jì le duōshǎo shùzì . nàlǐ yǒu shénme , rén zài zuò shénme , dōu jiǎng . "
pairs.english: “Not just how many numbers you wrote down. What's there, what people do—tell me all of it.”
pairs.hanzi: 别只讲你记了多少数字。那里有什么，人在做什么，都讲。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying le .
pairs.english: Tavi promised.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应了。

pairs.target: tā běnlái hái xiǎng gàosù yīwén , zìjǐ jìngrán bèi liúxià le , huàdàozuǐbiān yòu tíngzhù .
pairs.english: He had wanted to tell Iven how astonishing it was that they had kept him, but stopped with the words on his lips.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来还想告诉伊文，自己竟然被留下了，话到嘴边又停住。

pairs.target: yīwén yǐjīng zhīdào . tā liǎnshàng de gāoxìng yě bìng méiyǒu ài zhe biérén yíhàn .
pairs.english: Iven already knew. The happiness on his face didn't prevent someone else from being disappointed.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文已经知道。他脸上的高兴也并没有碍着别人遗憾。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn hòu , tǎ wéi gěi shào lǐ xiě le yìzhāng biàntiáo , shuōmíng dào xī qú de rìzi ,
pairs.english: After supper Tavi wrote Shaoli a note giving the day he would reach West Canal,
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭后，塔维给邵里写了一张便条，说明到西渠的日子，

pairs.target: zhī wèn ruò qiàhǎo xiàbān , néngfǒu jiàn yímiàn .
pairs.english: asking only if they could meet should he happen to be off duty.
pairs.hanzi: 只问若恰好下班，能否见一面。

pairs.target: tā méi xiě " děng wǒ ".
pairs.english: He didn't write “wait for me.”
pairs.hanzi: 他没写“等我”。

pairs.target: nà běn suànshù cè hái méi kàn wán , tā dǎsuàn qīnkǒu wèn néng bunéng zài jiè yízhèn .
pairs.english: He hadn't finished the arithmetic book and intended to ask in person to borrow it a while longer.
pairs.hanzi: 那本算术册还没看完，他打算亲口问能不能再借一阵。

pairs.target: pà wò lùguò , piējiàn xìnfēng shàng de xī qú , wèn tā néng bunéng shāo diǎn cōng huílái . "
pairs.english: Passing by, Pavo spotted West Canal on the envelope and asked if he could bring back some scallions.
pairs.hanzi:
帕沃路过，瞥见信封上的西渠，问他能不能捎点葱回来。
“

pairs.target: shuí gēn nǐ shuō nàlǐ mài cōng ? " "
pairs.english: “Who told you they sell scallions there?”
pairs.hanzi:
谁跟你说那里卖葱？”
“

pairs.target: nǐ búshì shuō shào lǐ yǒu bàngè chuāngtái ? "
pairs.english: “Didn't you say Shaoli has half a windowsill?”
pairs.hanzi: 你不是说邵里有半个窗台？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ xìnfēng zhuǎnguò qù , miǎnde tā wǎng shàng tiān yìzhāng càipǔ .
pairs.english: Tavi turned the envelope away so he couldn't add a recipe.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把信封转过去，免得他往上添一张菜谱。

pairs.target: pà wò yǐjīng kāishǐ suàn , liǎnggè rén de bàngè chuāngtái , dàodǐ suàn jǐgè chuāngtái .
pairs.english: Pavo had already started calculating how many windowsills two people's half-windowsills amounted to.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃已经开始算，两个人的半个窗台，到底算几个窗台。
